brief.title: Moving Camera Showcase - six achieved robot takes
brief.objective: Demonstrate script-driven actor/cart/phone overlap, approach, reveal, arc, arm translation and an uncut compound move.

document.logline: Walk from the entrance toward the workbench. The cart tracks alongside as the phone rises, then both settle.
